One actionable issue:

- **P1 — `.github/workflows/release.yml:86–87`: `load: true` with explicit `provenance: mode=max` fails on GitHub’s default Docker image store.** Buildx rejects this combination with “docker exporter does not currently support exporting manifest lists,” even for one platform. Enable the containerd image store before setup-buildx, or separate the push and local smoke-test exports. Evidence: [Buildx validation](https://github.com/docker/buildx/blob/master/build/opt.go#L480-L488), [GitHub runner setup guidance](https://docs.docker.com/build/ci/github-actions/multi-platform/#build-and-load-multi-platform-images).

No other confirmed actionable defects in the reviewed snapshot. I did not edit files or run suites.
